subject: Adding gheatmap to a tree with a collapsed or scaled node

messages.author: 14b9e51955638185
messages.subject: Adding gheatmap to a tree with a collapsed or scaled node
parts:
Hi 

I have a large tree and want to collapse or scale a node and add a heatmap. Is this possible? If so any tips. 

I have tried the following - it works fine without collapsing

p3<-collapse(ggtree(p), node=1157)
gheatmap(p3, data)

error in $ data.frame '('*tmp etc : replacement has 150 rows data has 1148)

I assume this due to the data frame size relative to the tree. Does anyone know how I can get the tip labels of non-collapsed tree to make the "correct sized" dataframe.


Have also tried scaling the clade of non-interest to 0.01 and adding heatmap. I get the legend appearing but not the heatmap.

Any thoughts and help would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks
Sebastian
